notes.title: 1.0.14 Update: Strength Increase
notes.content:
Increased the friction of most surfaces and increased arm strength. It seems a previous bug fix resulted in the arms being more slippery than intended. To combat this, I essentially made the main character feel stronger and grippier than before. 

This may result in a slightly easier experience, which I think is better than the alternative at this point - many have found it too tough.

notes.title: 1.0.13: Added some tweaks to the casino section
notes.content: Added some tweaks to the casino section so you know where to go while on top.

notes.title: 1.0.12 Stretchy Arms and Stuck Heads
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Some pretty big bug fixes in this update, I'm excited to fix some stuff that's been bothering me for a while:


 Head will now "un-stuck" itself automatically if you get in a tight spot. No need to click the menu button. 
 There's now a "are you sure" menu when you click "new game" and are about to override something. 
 The arms no longer stretch as much (they will in extreme situations). 
 There are no longer square artifacts when you move through smoke. 
 Made Violence a bit quieter, she was crying very loudly before
 Mobile controls can now be hidden
 Added a controls guide in the beginning. 

Thanks everyone, have fun in Hell!

notes.title: 1.0.6 update: "Unstuck" button
notes.content: Due to lots of reports of the player's head getting stuck in places, I've added a button you can press to hopefully get it free.

notes.title: 1.0.4 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Minor bug fixes, including:

 Shader issues fixed with lighting in the warehouse
 Invisible lights in the warehouse fixed
 Timer bug fixed, now shows minutes properly
